Iran Plane Suffers Cabin Damage After Tyre Burst During Emergency Landing

A Sepehran Airlines Boeing 737 experienced severe turbulence and cabin damage, including the detachment of its roof liner, during an emergency landing in Mashhad, Iran. The incident occurred after a suspected tyre burst caused the aircraft to shake violently. Belongings and the cabin's roof liner reportedly detached, and the plane lost cabin pressure. The aircraft was able to land safely.
